description: Check whether the house is open for checkIn, checkOut, and guests. petCount defaults to 0. A blocked stay returns unavailableReason booked. A stay shorter than a cached check-in minimum returns below_min_stay, minStayNights, and a suggestion. Dates are not reserved. This response does not include a price.

checkIn.description: Check-in date as YYYY-MM-DD in America/Los_Angeles.

petCount.description: Dogs or cats, 0 to 2. Defaults to 0 when omitted.
